# Realot Studio documentation

> Realot Studio is a browser-based 2D game engine with a visual editor, JavaScript gameplay scripting, PixiJS rendering and Rapier2D physics. The hosted engine and its documentation are published in place; there are no versioned documentation paths.

## Start here when you only have the documentation URL

Treat the directory containing this file as the documentation site root. Keep any deployment prefix (for example a GitHub Pages repository path) when resolving these relative paths.

1. Fetch `llms.txt` at the documentation root. You do not need to know any guide or API page path in advance.
2. Send the user question as a URL-encoded `q` parameter to `api/search?q=...`. This endpoint ranks the full documentation index and returns the closest matching pages with their titles, snippets, relevance scores and relative URLs.
3. Fetch the top result URLs returned by the search endpoint. Use those returned URLs exactly; do not guess page paths. For exact API questions, also retrieve `api/index.json`.
4. For broad questions, fetch `llms-full.txt`. For a manual fallback, fetch `search-index.json` and rank its records by title, description, headings, keywords and full page content.

The human-facing `search.html` uses the same ranked search endpoint when it is deployed on Cloudflare Pages. The browser search falls back to the local full-text index if the endpoint is unavailable.

## Scripting

- [Lifecycle](docs/scripting/lifecycle.html): Complete Realot Studio script lifecycle and callback reference.
- [Global scripting API](docs/scripting/globals.html): Reference for every built-in global function and service object available inside Realot Studio scripts.
- [Tween API](docs/scripting/tween.html): Animate numeric properties smoothly with tween(), choose from 33 easing curves, and stop animations with cancelTween().
- [Time scale & game speed](docs/scripting/time-scale.html): Slow motion, speed-up and freeze with time.scale, plus time.deltaTime, time.unscaledDeltaTime and time.elapsed.
- [Entity context](docs/scripting/entity-context.html): Reference the `this` object and entity-aware shortcuts available in Realot Studio scripts.
- [Entity shortcuts (this.x, this.transform)](docs/scripting/entity-shortcuts.html): What this is inside a script, which properties are flat shortcuts, and which require a specific component.
- [Finding & spawning entities](docs/scripting/finding-entities.html): The find/findAll/findWithTag family, plus spawn() for runtime-instantiated clones.
- [Input](docs/scripting/input.html): Keyboard, mouse, touch, gestures and virtual joystick input in Realot Studio.
- [Physics & navigation scripting](docs/scripting/physics.html): Use Rigidbody2D, Collider2D, raycasts and NavWorld2D from game scripts.
- [Collisions & triggers](docs/scripting/collisions.html): onCollisionEnter/Stay/Exit, onTriggerEnter/Exit, the other parameter, and physics layers from script.
- [Pathfinding & NavWorld2D](docs/scripting/navigation.html): navMoveToward, nav.findPath, named areas and per-area cost, and multi-agent avoidance.
- [Navigation: complete setup](docs/scripting/navigation-complete.html): Build, paint, name, script, tune, debug, and ship a complete Realot Studio navigation setup without skipping the hard parts.
- [State & messaging](docs/scripting/state-messaging.html): Build lightweight state machines and decoupled entity communication.
- [Timers, state & messaging](docs/scripting/timers-state.html): wait()/repeat() timers, the built-in this.state machine, and sendMessage/broadcastMessage.
- [Persistence](docs/scripting/persistence.html): Use transient global state and durable IndexedDB saves.
- [Save data](docs/scripting/saving.html): The save global: get/set/delete, save slots, and flushing writes.
- [Errors & debugging](docs/scripting/errors.html): How script errors are classified and reported, and the on-screen debug HUD.
- [Script API cookbook](docs/scripting/api-cookbook.html): Concrete Realot Studio script examples with setup, placement, required components, options, expected behavior, and common mistakes.

- [Runtime modules and global API](docs/api/runtime.html): Index of global functions and objects supplied to gameplay scripts in Realot Studio.
- [Complete script module member index](docs/api/script-modules.html): Complete source-verified member list for every script API module exposed by Realot Studio, including global utility modules and entity component APIs.
- [this (EntityContext) reference](docs/api/this.html): Complete reference for the current entity context, all flat shortcuts, pointer/touch helpers, navigation methods and per-entity script modules.
- [Option schemas & opts](docs/api/options.html): Exact option objects, types, defaults and semantics for the most important Realot Studio APIs, with machine-readable JSON for tooling and LLMs.
- [API requirements & complete usage map](docs/api/requirements.html): Complete prerequisites and usage map for Realot Studio scripting APIs.

- [Export an Android APK](docs/export/android.html): Build an Android APK directly from the Realot Studio Export window. The current editor allows three APK exports in a rolling 14-day period.
